items.title: Hal Galper interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, June 27, 2022
items.q: as an accompanist to Joe Williams and Anita O’Day

ctx.x: Pianist Hal Galper has led a diverse as a leader of his own trios, a sideman with Phil Woods and Cannonball Adderley, and as an accompanist to Joe Williams and Anita O’Day. He is a prolific composer and an in-demand jazz clinician.
Hal was interviewed via Zoom on June 27, 2022 by Monk Rowe, Director of the Fillius Jazz Archive.
